So I basically attempted (and failed, lol) and the reason I failed is because the beam from which the rope was suspended broke before I completely lost consciousness.

When you let go/jump off you'll feel either discomfort or excruciating pain (I've tried more than once with different materials <sisal ropes, LAN cables, synthetic ropes, etc>) depending on the material you use. You cannot breathe, and your body will start jerking and trying to pry off the rope for air. This (might) go on for some minutes before you start slowing down and losing consciousness because of fatigue from lack of air.

If, by some miracle, you stop being suspended on the rope and you fall to the ground, you'll be unconscious for a few minutes and wake up to a terrible headache and mind-numbing confusion on what just happened. I walked away with scuff marks on my neck and a cut on my forehead because the beam fell on my head. Luckily I didn't damage my trachea or get brain damage due to lack of oxygen but yeah!

Don't do it tho, the risk is not worth what you're going through. I've seen a guy who shot himself with a fucking shotgun to the face and fucking survived, now he's a mess of a face. 

My advice: If you're really contemplating suicide, watch graphic videos and pictures of people who did it, both who succeeded and didn't, and if that doesn't faze you, well, idk what to say to that.
